summary: Nanobiotix filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the pricing of an oversubscribed global follow-on offering (global offering) comprising a U.S. public offering of ADSs and an international offering of ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants. Terms: ADS price $38.98, share price €33.60 (14.92% discount to VWAP), PFW price €33.57; aggregate gross proceeds ~$98.6M (€85M). Jefferies, TD Cowen, Stifel are joint bookrunners. The offering is a capital raise, not a special situation; it expands equity without a strategic event.
